protocolDeviation.description: The delegated call repeated the identical four-query search batch. Its first unique batch is retained as feasibility evidence; the invocation is not counted as production-compliant.

note: All accepted rows are Expedia trend averages based on two-adult base rates and exclude taxes/fees. USD is normalized from the Expedia.com dollar display and remains a source-locale inference requiring FX review. No 1-star row was found and no accommodation model is fitted.
